intent: A side panel hosting the comment threads for a page: an Open / Resolved / All filter, thread previews, and the selected thread (pass a kit CommentThread as children) with Resolve. Built on kit Drawer and SegmentedControl; inline renders it in place.
useWhen: a page (invoice, document) has several comment threads
people filter open and resolved threads and open one
a header needs a Comments button with the open count
doNotUseWhen: one conversation on its own — CommentThread

threads.note: { id, title, preview, count, resolved?, updatedAt }[]

onSelect.note: (id | null) => void; null goes back to the list.

children.note: The selected thread, usually a CommentThread without a title.

composer.note: Shown under the list, e.g. a page-level CommentThread.

requirements: the trigger is a kit Button described by the open count Badge
the panel is the kit Drawer dialog (focus trap, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger)
the filter is a kit SegmentedControl radio group
threads are buttons; resolved threads say so to screen readers
All threads returns focus to the thread that was opened
list and thread crossfade on opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local CommentsDrawer or ThreadList
Do not re-implement the thread: pass a CommentThread as children
Do not use Tabs for the Open / Resolved / All filter
snippet:
<CommentsPanel threads={threads} open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} selectedId={selected} onSelect={setSelected} onResolve={resolve}>
  <CommentThread comments={comments} value={draft} onValueChange={setDraft} onSubmit={post} />
</CommentsPanel>
